name: Does adding a watermark upload my PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Watermarking is done entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Nothing is uploaded to any server.

name: Does PDFree store or log my files after processing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree runs entirely in your browser — there is no backend server that receives your files. Because nothing is uploaded, nothing can be stored, logged, or retained. Your document exists only in your browser's memory for the duration of the session and is cleared when you close the tab.

name: Can I add an image as a watermark instead of text?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not yet. PDFree currently supports text watermarks only. Image and logo watermark support is planned for a future update.

name: Can I control watermark opacity and position?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can adjust opacity (10–100%), font size, color, and rotation angle. Preview updates in real time before you apply the watermark.

name: Is this PDF watermark tool completely free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is a completely free PDF watermark tool — no subscription, no sign up, no watermarks or credits added to your output. Watermark as many PDFs as you need with no daily limit.

name: What is the difference between a watermark and a stamp on a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: The terms are often used interchangeably. A watermark is typically a semi-transparent text that repeats diagonally across every page (e.g. DRAFT at 30% opacity). A stamp is usually an opaque label placed once in a fixed position (e.g. APPROVED in a corner). PDFree lets you achieve either look by adjusting the opacity and position of the text watermark.

name: Can I remove a watermark from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree adds watermarks but does not remove them from existing PDFs. Watermarks added by PDFree are embedded as page content and cannot be automatically removed by basic tools.

Opacity of 100% makes the watermark fully opaque (solid, dark). Opacity of 20–30% creates the classic 'ghost' watermark that is visible but doesn't obscure the content underneath. Most use cases work well at 20–40%.

name: Will the watermark appear on every page?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The watermark is applied to all pages of the PDF by default.

name: Can I set the watermark color?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can set any hex color or choose from common presets. Light grey (#CCCCCC at 30% opacity) gives a professional, unobtrusive result.
